title: Switches - MS software versions MS 18.1.8.2 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new Recommended Release MS Switch firmware is now available

Important alerts: MS130-24(P) switches will reboot twice during the upgrade process when transitioning to MS 18.1.8 (or later) from MS 18.1.7 or earlier. This behavior is expected, and is not indicative of a problem.
New feature highlights: Group Policy ACL on MS130 & MS150
Maximum MAC support in MAC Allowlists
802.1x limited access mode with pre-auth GPACL
Local Status Page connectivity diagnostics enhancements
Traffic Mirroring: RSPAN & VLAN Based SPAN[General Fixed Issues]Resolved a bug that caused MS130 and stacked MS150 switches to unexpectedly reboot
General fixed issues: Fixed a bug impacting switches in stacked configurations that caused network loops when access ports using access policies were connected to ports on the active stack member, or other ports on the same stack member.
Resolved an issue that sometimes caused switches in stacked configurations to incorrectly reset STP priority to default (32768) when the active stack member transitioned between switches.
Fixed a bug that caused delays in processing link change events on MS130X/R and MS150 switches, which resulted in incorrect STP port status.
General known issues: MS130 and MS150 switches may not properly display IPv6 RA packets in dashboard packet captures
Ms120 known issues: Switches may fail to provide PoE power to legacy access points (always present)
Cable tests may report incorrect cable lengths
Ms130 known issues: MS130X mGig ports may fail to establish a link when both sides are forced to 100 Mbps full-duplex. If either side of the connection uses auto-negotiation the link will be established normally
Ms150 known issues: MS150 switches may intermittently negotiate USB-C Ethernet adapters at 10 Mbps half-duplex instead of the expected speed for the switchport, requiring a physical reseat to correct the issue.
Ms350x known issues: Switches may experience an unexpected reboot (present since MS 15)
Ms355 known issues: Switches in stack configuration may experience some ports failing to reconnect after a firmware upgrade
Ms425 known issues: In rare circumstances MS425 switches in stack configurations may encounter a software crash that results in a reboot

html:
Switches - MS software versions MS 18.1.8.2 changelog

Important alerts

  • MS130-24(P) switches will reboot twice during the upgrade process when transitioning to MS 18.1.8 (or later) from MS 18.1.7 or earlier. This behavior is expected, and is not indicative of a problem.

New feature highlights

  • Group Policy ACL on MS130 & MS150

  • Maximum MAC support in MAC Allowlists

  • 802.1x limited access mode with pre-auth GPACL

  • Local Status Page connectivity diagnostics enhancements

  • Layer 2 multicast live tool

  • Traffic Mirroring: RSPAN & VLAN Based SPAN[General Fixed Issues]Resolved a bug that caused MS130 and stacked MS150 switches to unexpectedly reboot

General fixed issues

  • Fixed a bug impacting switches in stacked configurations that caused network loops when access ports using access policies were connected to ports on the active stack member, or other ports on the same stack member.

  • Resolved an issue that sometimes caused switches in stacked configurations to incorrectly reset STP priority to default (32768) when the active stack member transitioned between switches.

  • Fixed a bug that caused delays in processing link change events on MS130X/R and MS150 switches, which resulted in incorrect STP port status.

General known issues

  • MS130 and MS150 switches may not properly display IPv6 RA packets in dashboard packet captures

Ms120 known issues

  • Switches may fail to provide PoE power to legacy access points (always present)

  • Cable tests may report incorrect cable lengths

Ms130 known issues

  • MS130X mGig ports may fail to establish a link when both sides are forced to 100 Mbps full-duplex. If either side of the connection uses auto-negotiation the link will be established normally

Ms150 known issues

  • MS150 switches may intermittently negotiate USB-C Ethernet adapters at 10 Mbps half-duplex instead of the expected speed for the switchport, requiring a physical reseat to correct the issue.

Ms350x known issues

  • Switches may experience an unexpected reboot (present since MS 15)

Ms355 known issues

  • Switches in stack configuration may experience some ports failing to reconnect after a firmware upgrade

Ms425 known issues

  • In rare circumstances MS425 switches in stack configurations may encounter a software crash that results in a reboot
